metadata.description: Plugins for traileo, agenticom, Kosher Compass, Waymark and Fantasy Hoops HQ: each connects an agent to the product's remote MCP server and teaches it where to start.

plugins.name: traileo-feedback
plugins.description: Read and act on traileo feedback: recorded web-page observations with their evidence attached.

plugins.name: agenticom-specs
plugins.description: Publish, read and share planning specs on agenticom.

plugins.name: kosher-compass
plugins.description: Search the kosher restaurants, groceries, synagogues and city guides published on Kosher Compass, each with its certifier and verification status, read its day by day vacations, and save a shared trip your group answers questions on.

plugins.name: waymark
plugins.description: Search the long-distance walking routes published on Waymark, read a route day by day with the stages, distances and stops its page states, and save a shared trip.

plugins.name: fantasy-hoops-hq
plugins.description: Fantasy basketball help from Fantasy Hoops HQ: the site's guides, NBA player lines and schedule counts, and, signed in, your saved leagues, roster, matchup planner and trade tools.
